11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D sandbox game with materials, chemicals, minerals, and animals.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript falling-sand game with a starter world, selectable materials, reactions, and touch-friendly controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with a responsive interface, material palette, cellular simulation, interactions, and reset/pause controls.
- Verified JavaScript syntax and loaded the game in Playwright; browser console showed no errors after fixes.

### Active
- Final check of the latest screenshot and any remaining gameplay issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `screenshots/little-worlds.png` if needed and make any final fixes.
2. Respond with a brief summary of the game and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/little-worlds.png`: Latest browser screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local HTTP server is running on port `3002`.
- The game includes sand, soil, salt, charcoal, water, oil, acid, lava, mercury, plants, seeds, moss, fish, mice, bacteria, stone, wood, ice, metal, glass, walls, fire, steam, smoke, and sparks.
